versions.changelog:
No functional or documentation changes detected in this release.

- Version bumped to 1.0.2 without any file updates.
- No new features, bug fixes, or adjustments introduced in this version.

- Refactored data structure: returns a unified tokens list and a new closeServer object to indicate which chain transactions are enabled or disabled.
- Updated output example and documentation to focus on supported chains/tokens and functional status (mint/burn/transfer) per chain.
- Standardized field definitions and provided detailed explanations for each configuration, improving user understanding.
- Updated description and trigger documentation for clearer AO network cross-chain scope.
- Added minBurnAmt and burnFee directly to AO network token entries for fee transparency.

Initial release of the check-aox-info skill.

- Query AOX basic information, including supported chains and tokens.
- Get details on available trading pairs, deposit/withdraw status by chain, and token withdrawal limits.
- Output includes chain token info, wrapped token details, and daily/per withdrawal limits.
- Status flags (like closeArweaveBurn or closeEthBurn) indicate if specific chain functions are temporarily disabled.
